arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-30' AND date < '2019-10-31'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made on 30 October 2019, which is "yesterday" counted back from the last day in the data.
assumptions: "Yesterday" is counted back from the last day in the data (2019-10-31), not from today, so it means 2019-10-30 (from 2019-10-30 00:00:00 up to but not including 2019-10-31).
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, and including those with errors or negative amounts.
